findings.current_drug_context: Type 2 diabetes (11 yrs) with chronic kidney disease, on metformin and gliclazide (a sulfonylurea). No SGLT2 inhibitor. Last medication review 2020.
findings.drift: Chronic kidney disease qualifies for SGLT2-inhibitor cardiorenal protection under current guidance, but Tomasz is not on one.

eligibility.reasoning: Type 2 diabetes with CKD. eGFR 51 mL/min/1.73m² is above the initiation threshold. Indication is independent of glycaemic control.

contraindication_check.notes: No SGLT2 hypersensitivity, no recurrent genital/urinary infection on record, not insulin-dependent. eGFR above initiation threshold. No contraindication identified.

findings.recommended_action: Initiate an SGLT2 inhibitor for renal protection alongside current therapy; counsel on sick-day rules.
findings.patient_explanation: Guidance for people with your kidney and diabetes history has changed. There is a tablet that helps protect your kidneys, and you are not on it yet. It is common and not urgent — worth a review with your GP.
findings.clinician_summary: 66M, T2DM + CKD (eGFR 51), on metformin + sulfonylurea, no SGLT2i. Meets 2023 renal indication; no contraindication. Consider SGLT2i.
findings.draft_prescription: Dapagliflozin 10 mg orally once daily. Review renal function in 4–6 weeks.

findings.current_drug_context: Type 2 diabetes (7 yrs) with established cardiovascular disease, on metformin and sitagliptin (a DPP-4 inhibitor). No SGLT2 inhibitor. Last medication review 2021.
findings.drift: Established cardiovascular disease qualifies for SGLT2-inhibitor cardiorenal protection under current guidance, but Sofia is on a DPP-4 inhibitor instead.

eligibility.reasoning: Type 2 diabetes with established CVD. eGFR 72 mL/min/1.73m² is well above the initiation threshold. Indication is independent of glycaemic control.

contraindication_check.notes: No SGLT2 hypersensitivity, no recurrent genital/urinary infection on record, not insulin-dependent. eGFR well above initiation threshold. No contraindication identified.

findings.recommended_action: Add an SGLT2 inhibitor for cardiovascular protection; review whether the DPP-4 inhibitor is still needed.
findings.patient_explanation: The guidance for people with your heart and diabetes history has been updated. There is a tablet that helps protect your heart, and you are not on it yet. This is common and not an emergency — worth a quick review with your GP.
findings.clinician_summary: 61F, T2DM + established CVD (eGFR 72), on metformin + DPP-4i, no SGLT2i. Meets 2023 cardiovascular indication; no contraindication. Consider SGLT2i; review DPP-4i.
findings.draft_prescription: Dapagliflozin 10 mg orally once daily. Reassess ongoing need for sitagliptin at next review.
